appended_column_rule: the entry of every row is 1, so the letter appended to the codeword of the message polynomial a(x) = a_0 + a_1 x + ... + a_7 x^7 is a(1) = a_0 + ... + a_7
check_polynomial_note: h = (x^29 - 1)/gcd(g1, g2, g3, x^29 - 1) has degree 8 and is the product of an irreducible factor of degree 7 of x^29 - 1 and (x - 1)
description: A one-generator quasi-cyclic code of index 3 and circulant size 29 over GF(7), of dimension 8, with one appended coordinate.
generator_matrix_rule: rows i = 0..7: the coefficient vectors (lowest degree first, length 29 each) of x^i*g1, x^i*g2, x^i*g3 modulo x^29 - 1, side by side, followed by the entry of the appended column
readme_construction:
The code is a one-generator quasi-cyclic code of index 3 and circulant size 29 over GF(7), with one appended coordinate. The generator polynomials are g1(x) = x^26 + 4*x^25 + 5*x^24 + 5*x^23 + 6*x^22 + 5*x^21 + 6*x^20 + 4*x^19 + x^18 + 4*x^17 + 4*x^16 + 4*x^15 + 3*x^14 + 5*x^13 + x^12 + 2*x^10 + x^9 + x^8 + 2*x^7 + x^6 + 3*x^5 + 2*x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + x + 5, g2(x) = x^27 + 2*x^26 + x^25 + x^24 + 3*x^23 + x^22 + 2*x^21 + 6*x^20 + 5*x^19 + 3*x^17 + 2*x^16 + 4*x^14 + 3*x^13 + 6*x^12 + 5*x^11 + x^10 + 6*x^8 + 3*x^7 + 3*x^6 + 3*x^5 + 2*x^4 + 4*x^3 + 3*x^2 + 2*x + 2 and g3(x) = x^27 + 4*x^26 + x^25 + 3*x^24 + 4*x^23 + 5*x^22 + 2*x^21 + 2*x^20 + 3*x^19 + 2*x^18 + 2*x^17 + 3*x^16 + x^15 + 3*x^13 + 3*x^12 + 6*x^11 + 2*x^10 + x^9 + 2*x^8 + 3*x^7 + 2*x^6 + 5*x^5 + 4*x^4 + x^3 + 6*x^2 + 2.

A polynomial of degree below 29 is written as its coefficient vector of length 29, lowest degree first. For i = 0, 1, ..., 7, row i of the generator matrix consists of the coefficient vectors of x^i*g1(x), x^i*g2(x) and x^i*g3(x), each reduced modulo x^29 - 1, followed by the entry 1. The message polynomial a(x) = a_0 + a_1*x + ... + a_7*x^7 therefore gives the codeword whose first 87 entries are the coefficient vectors of a(x)*g1(x), a(x)*g2(x) and a(x)*g3(x) modulo x^29 - 1 and whose last entry is a(1) = a_0 + a_1 + ... + a_7.

The [87, 8, 63] code formed by the first 87 coordinates has the same circulant size, index and check polynomial h(x) = (x^29 - 1)/gcd(g1(x), g2(x), g3(x), x^29 - 1) = x^8 + 5*x^7 + 2*x^6 + x^5 + 5*x^4 + 2*x^3 + 3*x^2 + x + 1 as the [87, 8, 63] code listed in Chen's database of quasi-twisted codes and credited there to Arhan Canli, and it is a different code: the two row spaces meet only in the zero vector.

Adding a zero coordinate gives a linear [89, 8, 64] code, which exceeds the lower bound 63 listed at codetables.de for n = 89, k = 8 on 2026-11-10.
relation_to_published_work: The quasi-cyclic [87, 8, 63] code formed by the first 87 coordinates has the same circulant size, index and check polynomial as the [87, 8, 63] code listed in Chen's online database of quasi-twisted codes (http://databases.cs.hkr.se/qtcodes/) for Arhan Canli; it is a different code (the two row spaces meet only in the zero word).
type: quasi-cyclic code with one appended column
